en.rec: Lights out 23:20, up at 06:15 — 6h 48m of sleep inside 6h 55m in bed, so 98% of the time in bed was actually asleep. That is the cleanest night of the window: only 7 minutes awake against 36, 40 and 16 on the other short nights. The score came in at 84, two under the night before, and it is a short night that scored well rather than a long one that scored badly. Composition is the reason: 73 minutes of deep sleep, 18% of the night, against 248 light and 87 REM. Deep is the story of the last two mornings. It ran 48, 48, 61 and 50 minutes on the four recorded nights up to Wed 5, then jumped to 82 and 73. The thin-deep stretch the dashboard flagged on Thursday has closed. REM went the other way — 87 minutes after 113 and 120 — which is what a night cut 1h 45m shorter than the previous one does first. The autonomics are the strongest reading in the window. HRV 42 for the second night running, five over the seven-night average of 37 and up from 31 at the start of the window. RHR 53, one under the night before and the lowest value on the chart. Average stress 17 so far this morning, though the day is only seven hours old. Readiness 85 — high. Three tracked nights in a row now (Wed 5, Thu 6, Fri 7): the wear gap that swallowed the Mon 3 and Tue 4 evenings has not repeated, and those two empty slots will roll off the chart by tomorrow. The one thing to watch is length, not quality. Two of the last three nights were 8h 32m and 8h 33m; last night was 6h 48m. On a vacation week that is fine, but if tonight comes in short as well, REM is the first thing that pays for it.

hr.rec: Gašenje svjetla u 23:20, ustajanje u 06:15 — 6h 48m sna unutar 6h 55m u krevetu, dakle 98% vremena u krevetu bilo je stvarno spavanje. To je najčišća noć u prozoru: samo 7 minuta budnosti naspram 36, 40 i 16 na ostalim kratkim noćima. Ocjena je 84, dvije niže od noći prije, ali radi se o kratkoj noći koja je dobro ocijenjena, a ne o dugoj koja je loše prošla. Razlog je sastav: 73 minute dubokog sna, 18% noći, naspram 248 lakog i 87 REM-a. Duboki san je priča zadnja dva jutra. Išao je 48, 48, 61 i 50 minuta kroz četiri zabilježene noći do sri 5., a onda skočio na 82 i 73. Niz tankog dubokog sna, koji je dashboard označio u četvrtak, zatvoren je. REM je otišao u suprotnom smjeru — 87 minuta nakon 113 i 120 — što je prvo što strada kad je noć kraća za 1h 45m od prethodne. Autonomika je najjače očitanje u prozoru. HRV 42 drugu noć zaredom, pet iznad prosjeka od 37 i naviše s 31 na početku prozora. RHR 53, jedan niže od noći prije i najniža vrijednost na grafu. Prosječni stres 17 jutros, iako je dan star tek sedam sati. Spremnost 85 — visoka. Sad su tri zabilježene noći zaredom (sri 5., čet 6., pet 7.): rupa u nošenju koja je progutala večeri pon 3. i uto 4. nije se ponovila, a ta dva prazna mjesta ispadaju s grafa već sutra. Jedino što treba pratiti je trajanje, ne kvaliteta. Dvije od zadnje tri noći bile su 8h 32m i 8h 33m; sinoćnja 6h 48m. Na godišnjem je to u redu, ali ako i večeras bude kratko, REM je prvi koji to plaća.
